But 8 cores 9.4 -> +9.5. m4 (cores nominal ~7.3, shared LOW): +2..+4.7 residual. CONCLUSION: residual is NOT a per-core gain (single hot core m16 fine). It grows with TOTAL die power / number of hot cores. Looks like a die-wide nonlinearity. Single hot core fine, all-hot large. But m4 shared LOW cores ~7.3 gives +3ish, and m16 single core 9.4 shared nominal gives 0. So it is about SUM of core power (mutual heating / total). Candidate: global "die heating" model error: model's boundary conductance too high => under-predicts when total power large. i.e. global R error or a global power_gain. Actually package residual correlates with total power. Consider: model under-predicts at high TOTAL power regardless of block. Shared MAX cores low (m14) total ~44W -> residual small though. Hmm shared max total = 5.16+7.74+6.45+5.16+5.16 + 8*0.75 = 29.67+6 = ~35.7W? Let me recompute.
